verdict.line: You lose if you let him soak Q (Last Rites) stacks and bone-wall you into a bad trade; you win if you abuse your mobility before he hits 6 and snowball the 54.9% head-to-head into a stomp.

brief.thesis: This matchup is even by the numbers (54.9% Fiora over 1039 games) because both champions scale off repeated instances of damage rather than one burst combo. Fiora's Passive (Duelist) and E (Burst of Speed) reward landing successive hits and Lunges, while Yorick's Q (Last Rites) rewards him for simply connecting one empowered auto per cooldown cycle. Whoever controls the number of exchanges per level — not the size of any single trade — wins the lane.

theirWindow.when: Q (Last Rites) is up and he's in range
theirWindow.what: He will walk up for one empowered auto to heal and dig a grave. Use W (Riposte) to parry that specific auto — it's his only source of sustain in the exchange, and denying it removes his entire reason to engage.

yourWindow.when: His Q (Last Rites) and E (Mourning Mist) are both down
yourWindow.what: Double-Lunge with Q (the dash repeats within a couple seconds for free) into E (Burst of Speed) to stack 3-4 attacks of Passive (Duelist) before he can heal or slow you back out.

playing.title: Parry his empowered auto with W
playing.detail: Riposte (W) is a 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown that reflects damage on his next basic attack. Hold it specifically for the auto right after he casts Q (Last Rites) — that's the only hit he needs to land.

playing.title: Double-Lunge every all-in
playing.detail: Q (Lunge) can be cast a second time within a couple seconds for free. Always use both charges in one engage — the first repositions through his wall, the second lands the real damage.

playing.title: Punish his wall placement
playing.detail: Dark Procession (W) is a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown wall. If he drops it mid-trade to block your escape, your Q (Lunge) dash can often reposition around it — don't panic-flash.

playing.title: Track Maiden timers from level 6
playing.detail: Eulogy of the Isles (R) is 160s on first cast, dropping to 100s at rank 2-3. Once Maiden is up, avoid extended skirmishes near her — his attacks against her target get bonus damage.

playing.title: Stack passive before committing ultimate
playing.detail: Blade Waltz (R) deals less damage on successive hits to the same target, so it rewards picking a target you've already weakened with Passive (Duelist) stacks rather than opening with it cold.

playing.title: Deny graves when you can
playing.detail: Last Rites (Q) digs a grave on hit or kill, which feeds his Maiden. Trading so he whiffs Q, or killing minions before his empowered auto lands, slows his mid-game power spike.

playing.title: Use E's move speed to disengage from ganks
playing.detail: Burst of Speed (E) grants move speed per attack or Lunge landed during its window. Pop it after your trade combo, not before, so you're fast when his jungler or Maiden arrives.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability breakdowns and tactical sequencing are my own read on how to apply that data in lane.

stats.opponentTip: Pressure Yorick before reaching level 3 to gain lane control. Block any of his skills with [W] to easily gain the upper hand.
